title: Audit selected scatter parity across word and record checks
body:
## Summary

Adds `research/scatter-export-parity-audit` for the revision-5 `supplier-boundary-audit` card. The exact selected bit-word counterexample is:

```diff
 scatter[0] = [4,5,6,7,8]
+scatter[0] += [0,0]
```

The full symbolic checker XORs list occurrences, so the extra pair cancels. The exporter uses membership and emits one extra ADD. Record legality accepts; the native formal-column checker rejects. This demonstrates why symbolic acceptance and record legality cannot replace the exported endpoint check.

The selected generator produces unique rows and the full supplier replay binds the original bytes. This does not invalidate the selected result. The package includes a sufficient uniqueness guard as an opt-in successor candidate, exact source pins, proof, deterministic receipts and a concrete adoption handoff. Frozen sources and selected-frontier metadata remain unchanged.

Scientific base: main `d878e1f048823de10e57e3dc58522d345a5fcd8d`; refreshed compatibility against `47fa55b3cd8c7cf8879206f33569bc59d637dad8`. Audited inputs and guidance are unchanged. [Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2976).

Credit eumemic's checker and PR543/555/589 lineage, DreamingOfClouds' retained bit-supplier lineage, Dylan Crow's exporter/native checkers, and Douglas Colkitt's source bindings. Substantial automated assistance is disclosed in the package; predecessor notices and licenses are retained.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the unchanged word passes full symbolic checking and exact exported replay on all 661 arbitrary input columns, plus native legality and five-stage columns.
  **After the two-entry edit:** full symbolic checking still passes all H1-H5 and four conclusion flags; exported records rise from 27,234 to 27,235. With only dirty input 472 set, target 111 incorrectly becomes one. Native legality retains mass 5,129 and nine COPY/ERASE pairs; native columns exit 2 at `local defining-decoder full formal column`.
- A single-occurrence control fails the symbolic checker and exports byte-identically to the paired mutant. The tested uniqueness guard rejects the pair. Parity normalization of this exact fixture recovers the original word and record bytes.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, eight behavioral groups, optimized Python 3.14 checks, Ruff, and publication-byte preflight pass. The research-workflow suite passes 158 tests with 18 existing platform/environment skips on macOS. A separate internal review reran the source-bound result, controls and native path with no blocking finding.
- Optional native replay compiles unchanged C++ sources with the authenticated checked 128-bit `cpp_int` stand-in. It is not a fresh system-Boost build. Full cold supplier replay, all-size transfer and hosted CI are separate obligations; no new kappa is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/scatter-export-parity-audit
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/scatter-export-parity-audit/native.py
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/scatter-export-parity-audit
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Nine new files in one opt-in research package. No production adoption, source repinning or selected-frontier change.
